PixelSpacing.Notes: Dimension of every pixel. It is also the dimension of every voxel in every spatial direction due to the isotropic reconstruction used. It represents the resolution of the microCT acquisition.

RotationStep_degree.Notes: Step between two consecutive projections; could be described by DICOM tags (0054,0052) RotationInformationSequence or (0018,1144) AngularStep

Threshold.Notes: Gray-scale value chose for segmentation of the digital image. Over the values pixels are marked as bone. It influence the Measurements

Local.Notes: Parameters for local thresholding are several and dependent by the implemented algorithm.

TbTh_microm.Notes: Trabecular Thickness. The Tb.Th is estimated using a plate like model of trabecular structure. It is a 2D parameter and the result here shown it is the mean of every Tb.Th calculated for each tomographic slice.

TbSp_microm.Notes: Trabecular Separation. The Tb.Sp is estimated using a plate like model of trabecular structure. It is a 2D parameter and the result here shown it is the mean of every Tb.Sp calculated for each tomographic slice.

TbN_1overmm.Notes: Trabecular Number. The Tb.N is estimated using a plate like model of trabecular structure. It is a 2D parameter and the result here shown is the mean of every Tb.N calculated for each tomographic slice.

BVoverTV_percentage.Notes: Bone Volume on Total Volume ratio. The BV/TV is estimated dividing the sum of voxels marked as bone by the sum of voxels composing the volume of interest. (Parfitt et al. 1987)

SMI.Notes: Structure Model Index. SMI is a topological index, giving an estimate of the characteristic form in terms of plates and rods composing the 3D structure. For ideal plate and rod the index assumes respectively the values 0 and 3, whereas for a mixed structure the SMI-index lies in between 0 and 3 (Hildebrand et al. 1997)

DirectTbTh_microm.Notes: Direct Trabecular Thickness. The parameter Direct Tb.Th gives a model independent thickness of the 3D structure and it was calculated using the sphere method (Hildebrand et al. 1997)

ConnectivityDensity.Notes: Connectivity density is a parameter for the measure of the degree to which a structure is multiply connected, and hence reports the maximal number of branches that can be broken in a network before the structure is separated into two parts (Odgaard et al. 1993)

HasMILmatrix.Notes: Mean Intercept Length. The MIL of trabecular bone represents the mean distance between bone-marrow interfaces measured in a selected volume along different angular directions. These distances are computed dividing the total sum of the distance between bone-marrow interfaces, measured along the different directions, by the number of interfaces. The polar diagram in 3D of these lengths was found to have the shape of an ellipsoid

primary_eigenvalue.Notes: It represents the primary direction of the ellipsoid.

secondary_eigenvalue.Notes: It represents the secondary direction of the ellipsoid.

tertiary_eigenvalue.Notes: It represents the tertiary direction of the ellipsoid.

primary_eigenvector.Notes: It is the versor of the primary direction of the ellipsoid

x.Notes: It is the versor component along the x direction

y.Notes: It is the versor component along the y direction

z.Notes: It is the versor component along the z direction

secondary_eigenvector.Notes: It represents the versor of the secondary direction of the ellipsoid

x.Notes: It is the versor component along the x direction

y.Notes: It is the versor component along the y direction

z.Notes: It is the versor component along the z direction

tertiary_eigenvector.Notes: It represents the versor of the tertiary direction of the ellipsoid

x.Notes: It is the versor component along the x direction

y.Notes: It is the versor component along the y direction

z.Notes: It is the versor component along the z direction
